DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological Jaundice of the Newborn (likely progressing to severe hyperbilirubinemia).

The total bilirubin of 16.1 mg/dL is significantly elevated, but the direct bilirubin is low (0.7 mg/dL) and the hemoglobin is normal, which rules out biliary obstruction and significant hemolysis at this stage. I recommend immediate phototherapy and close monitoring to prevent kernicterus.
